recommendations.recommended_primary_source: TomTom Traffic Flow API (Tamil Nadu / Coimbatore-Avinashi Corridor)
recommendations.backup_source: METR-LA / PEMS-BAY Open Speed Benchmark (Caltrans PeMS)
recommendations.strategic_rationale: Strategy 1 (Tamil Nadu First via TomTom/HERE real traffic flow API) provides genuine empirical speeds directly linkable to the P1 Coimbatore-Avinashi road network graph. Strategy 2 (METR-LA open benchmark) serves as a 100% open, offline reproducible benchmark to validate spatio-temporal ML algorithms with 7M+ real sensor readings.
